name: fabflows
description: Routes work from an expensive lead model to tool-scoped worker agents (explorer and researcher on Haiku, editor and test-runner on Sonnet, refuter and investigator on Opus) and makes the lead re-verify what they report. The using-fabflows skill is the session entrypoint and standing opt-in to fabflows:build, a deterministic loop in which an Opus builder implements a spec and a fresh reviewer returns ACCEPT or REWORK. The brainstorming skill turns a rough idea into that spec, the fabflows-setup and ticket skills keep it in a GitHub Issues, Jira or Linear ticket, with a hook that requires the ticket's trailers on commits and its key in the PR title, and the trace skill writes an audit trace report of every merged change. An ACTIVE guard hook asks before package installs and package runners such as npx, denies them in workers, and blocks commits and pushes to a default branch, destructive commands (including ones written into a Makefile, npm script or shell script) and credential reads and writes; it fails open.
